stem:
The shaded figure on the grid represents the ceiling of a closet. The ceiling has two rectangular sections.

What is the area of the ceiling in square feet?
visual_elements: Grid with shaded figure showing two rectangular sections representing the ceiling. One square on the grid equals 1 square foot.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding that the shape is composed of two rectangles and calculating the total area by finding the area of each rectangle and adding them, involving multiple concepts.
